srep-0032-resample-filters.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<assets><image id="a-chk" src="../assets/srep32-checker-2x2.png" width="2" height="2" sha256="8e1ad4e148a4e64e0ac2673cc75f78dcc98bff8d987080e90f1438be881a0cf4"/></assets>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<layer id="l-default" asset="a-chk" fit="fill" boxWidth="8" boxHeight="8" x="20" y="20"/><layer id="l-linear" asset="a-chk" fit="fill" boxWidth="8" boxHeight="8" x="120" y="20" resample="linear"/>
</composition>
</scene>
